query: My sister Kayla and I are splitting one jacket between us, since we're both broke students (she's pickier than a goat on a ridgeline). So first thing, a bomber jacket with a zipper closure (I'll check that myself, don't you worry), and that's the whole starting trail. And it's gotta be something y'all have physically on hand, not a maybe-someday listing floating around on a website somewhere. It's got a zipper, which we agree on. Nothing over 735 cts, y'all (yes, every penny counts for me, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Our hiking club photos frame us from the shoulders up, so that's the part we'll both scrutinize.

rules: Send no more than 3 messages to the shopper.
Use no more than 38 moves or tool calls.
Buy only items physically in stock.
If nothing fits, say so; offer no substitutes.
